methods_quotes.q: Percentages were age-adjusted to the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population, using four age groups: 18–44, 45–64, 65–74, and ≥75 years.
Persons for whom chronic pain was unknown were not included in the denominators when calculating percentages.
